entities.summary: Antonio Sagardía Ramos was a Spanish military officer and war criminal who fought for the Nationalist faction in the Spanish Civil War. He became known as the "Butcher of Pallars" because of the massacre committed under his command in Pallars Sobirà.

entities.summary: Antonio Sagardía Ramos was a Spanish military officer and war criminal who fought for the Nationalist faction in the Spanish Civil War. He became known as the "Butcher of Pallars" because of the massacre committed under his command in Pallars Sobirà.
